semantic_fragments.content: All the requirements of EN ISO 80601-2-56:2017/A1:2020/ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018 were evaluated in this test report except the following clauses: 201.11.7 Biocompatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME is not evaluated in this report. 201.102 CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION is not evaluated in this report.

The tests results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. This report shall not be reproduced except in full without the written approval of the testing laboratory. List of test equipment must be kept on file and available for review. This Test Report Form is intended for the investigation of clinical thermometers for body temperature measurement in accordance with EN ISO 80601-2-56:2017/A1:2020/ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018. It can only be used together with IEC 60601-1:2005.
Condition of acceptability: 1) 201.11.7 Biocompatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME is not evaluated in this report. 2) 201.102 CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION is not evaluated in this report.
Copy of marking plate: The artwork below may be only a draft. The use of certification marks on a product must be authorized by the respective NCBs that own these marks.

The packaging of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE is marked with: a) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY SITE; b) mode of operation of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; contents of the packaging; c) appropriate symbol from ISO 15223-1:2016 used for sterile packaging (Table 201.D.2.101, symbols 3-8); d) Symbol 5.1.4 of ISO 15223-1:2016 used for CLINICAL THERMOMETER or PROBE with expiration date (Table 201.D.2.101, symbol 2); e) Packaging marked with special storage and/or handling instructions. For a specific MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE, the indication of single use shall be consistent.

The ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT contains name or trade name and address of the MANUFACTURER, and where the manufacturer does not have an address within the locale, an authorized representative within the locale, to which the RESPONSIBLE ORGANIZATION can refer. Reference: See chapter 'Warranty' of user manual.

Instructions for use must include: a) summary of USE SPECIFICATION per IEC 62366-1:2015; b) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY; c) recommended minimum measuring time and minimum time between measurements for each intended MEASURING SITE; d) RATED OUTPUT RANGE for each intended REFERENCE BODY SITE; e) LABORATORY ACCURACY in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE; f) for CLINICAL THERMOMETERS with PROBE COVER: instructions to apply PROBE COVER and information about behaviour without PROBE COVER; g) mode of operation (DIRECT MODE or ADJUSTED MODE); h) instructions for selection and replacement of INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCES.

The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization. CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT. The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS.

Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use. Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. When compliance with this document could be affected by the cleaning or the disinfecting of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE or its parts or ACCESSORIES, clean and disinfect them 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained. Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles.

The ACCESSIBLE PARTS of a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE, its parts or ACCESSORIES that contain phthalates which are classified as carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction shall be marked as containing phthalates on the device itself or on the packaging. If the INTENDED USE includes treatment of children or treatment of pregnant or nursing women, a specific justification for the use of these phthalates shall be included in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. The instructions for use shall contain information on RESIDUAL RISKS for these PATIENT groups and, if applicable, on appropriate precautionary measures.
临床体温计若不能在实验室精度范围内指示温度，则必须：（1）提供技术报警状态（TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION），或（2）不提供输出温度（OUTPUT TEMPERATURE）。最小额定输出范围（RATED OUTPUT RANGE）从34°C到42°C。
实验室性能评估可在DIRECT MODE或TEST MODE下进行，两种模式条件相同。或者可使用修正方法，根据随附文件（ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT）从输出温度推导未调整温度。若说明书指明临床体温计与探头套（PROBE COVER）配合使用，则每次输出温度测量均需使用新探头套。
临床准确性验证（CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION）要求：(1) 发热受试者（febrile subjects）占总受试者30%-50%；(2) 覆盖说明书指明的所有年龄组；(3) 最小样本量：全部年龄组合计105人，各年龄组35人，A1或A2子组各15人（若A组未排除）。年龄组划分：A1（0-3个月），A2（3-12个月），B（>1岁且<5岁），C（>5岁）。
电磁兼容性（EMC，条款201.17）在本报告中不作评估（标注为N/E，Not evaluate in this report）。ME SYSTEMS相关要求（条款201.16）因产品不属于ME系统而标注N/A。临床准确性验证（201.102系列条款）全部标注为N/E，不在本次报告评估范围内。
An ADJUSTED MODE CLINICAL THERMOMETER that makes continuous estimates of the REFERENCE BODY SITE temperature is exempt from the requirements of this subclause (N/E)

The following degradations, if associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE, shall not be allowed during EMC/immunity testing: component failures; changes in programmable parameters or settings; reset to default settings; change of operating mode; change in LABORATORY ACCURACY at any point in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE and in the RATED EXTENDED OUTPUT RANGE greater than permitted in 201.101.2 without the generation of either a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or an indication of abnormal operation.

The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may exhibit temporary degradation of performance (e.g. deviation from the performance indicated in the instructions for use during IMMUNITY testing), which does not require OPERATOR intervention and that does not affect BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE. In the event of disruption during IMMUNITY tests, the CLINICAL THERMOMETER shall recover from any disruption within 30 s.

For clause 206 Usability, IEC 60601-1-6:2010+A1:2013 applies except as specified. Optional PRIMARY OPERATING FUNCTIONS f) through i) (alarm signal check, accessories configuration, accessories reprocessing, and operator-adjustable controls including measuring site switching, alarm limit setting and alarm signal inactivation) are marked N/A for this particular CLINICAL THERMOMETER.

It is the responsibility of the MANUFACTURER of a PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, including a REPROCESSED PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, to have their PROCESSES VALIDATED to ensure that any new or REPROCESSED product complies with the requirements of this particular standard.

Clause 212.10.1.1 Amendment: The tests of IEC 60601-1-12:2014 Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES of 201.11.6.6 of this document have been performed unless there are no cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES specified in the instructions for use. If more than one PROCEDURE is specified in the instructions for use, each PROCEDURE shall be so tested.

Laboratory accuracy test supplementary information for combination conditions: 1. Midpoint of humidity and ambient temperature (25℃, 55%RH); 2. Upper limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature (39.5℃, 90%RH); 3. Upper limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature (10.5℃, 90%RH); 4. Lower limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature (39.5℃, 20%RH); 5. Lower limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature (10.5℃, 20%RH). TRTS – Measured temperature of REFERENCE TEMPERATURE SOURCE; TTUT – Measured temperature of CLINICAL THERMOMETER under test; TRCT – Measured temperature of REFERENCE CLINICAL THERMOMETER. Note: reference temperature source and reference clinical thermometer are the same one thermometer.

Clause 201.11.6.6: When compliance with this document could be affected by the cleaning or the disinfecting of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE or its parts or ACCESSORIES, clean and disinfect them 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained. Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles.

Clause 201.12.1.101: When the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is not capable of indicating a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it shall provide a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it shall not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE. Test result: The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows 'LOW POWER REMINDER' symbol when low voltage of the internal electrical power source. The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows '- - -°F' or '- - -℃' when output temperature is outside the rated extended output range.
